question: In his address to the nation on 11 May 2020, Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced a special economic package, called 'Atma Nirbhar Bharat' Package, worth Rs. _______ lakh crore.
solution:
The correct answer is **" 20 ".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** 'Atma Nirbhar Bharat' **or self-reliant India campaign is the vision of the new India.
 
• This campaign is launched by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi.**
 
• The aim of this campaign is to make the country and its citizens of the country self-reliant.
 
• **Five pillars **of this campaign - Economy, Infrastructure, System, Vibrant Demography, and Demand.
 
• The 20 crore lakh package is 10% of the GDP of the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 Other campaigns launched by Narendra Modi:-

 
• **Digital India -** It was launched to create digital empowerment. The program was launched on July 1, 2015.

 
 
• This initiative helps to connect rural India with internet connections.
 
• It consists of three components: the development of secure and stable digital infrastructure, delivering government services digitally, and digital literacy.
 
 
 
• **Mann ki Baat -** The first broadcast of Mann ki Baat was done on October 3, 2014.
 
 
• It is an Indian radio program.
 
• PM Narendra Modi addresses the Indian citizens with ongoing issues and ideas of national importance.
 
 
 
• **Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao -** This scheme is launched in 22nd January, 2015 in Panipat, Haryana to raise the concern of gender discrimination and empower women.
 
 
• The scheme emphasizes educating the citizens about discrimination and to giver equal opportunities to girls also.
